name: Founder Insight & Market Shift Discovery
description: Deterministic strategic framework to discover, validate, and translate founder insights, contrarian beliefs, macro market shifts, category opportunities, and signal/risk dynamics into persistent organizational intelligence.
logic: Great companies begin with unique insights, not simply better products. Many founders can describe what they built; far fewer can articulate why they built it, what insight led them there, and why the market is finally ready today.
chainsOfThought: Step 1: Initiate Discovery -> Confirm Scope & Objectives -> Gather Raw Company Documentation -> Formulate Initial Hypotheses
Step 2: Capture Founder Intelligence -> Interview Founder -> Extract Experiences, Motivations, Convictions & Defining Moments -> Build Founder Profile
Step 3: Discover Strategic Insights -> Challenge Conventional Industry Wisdom -> Identify Unresolved Root Causes & Earned Truths -> Build Insight Inventory
Step 4: Analyze Market Shifts -> Evaluate Technology, Regulatory, Economic & Behavioral Transformations -> Separate Trends from Structural Shifts
Step 5: Validate Founder-Market Fit -> Assess Credibility, Network & Unfair Advantage -> Audit Conviction & Timing
Step 6: Architect the Opportunity -> Formulate Market Thesis & Category Definition -> Draft Opportunity Architecture
Step 7: Validate Evidence & Score Confidence -> Audit 5-Level Evidence Matrix -> Compute 5-Tier Decision Confidence Score
Step 8: Generate Strategic Intelligence -> Synthesize Strategic Intelligence Package -> Produce 30+ Reusable Knowledge Assets
Step 9: Human Review & Approval -> Request WebSocket Sign-Off on Thesis, Category & Positioning -> Obtain Founder Sign-Off
Step 10: Publish & Integrate -> Store Memory Objects in Polytope Graph -> Trigger Downstream Workflow Synchronization
bestPractices: Never manufacture a story; discover and validate authentic founder advantage.
Distinguish clearly between Facts, Evidence, Assumptions, Hypotheses, and Recommendations.
Every major recommendation must explicitly report its Decision Confidence Level.
Require explicit human founder sign-off before triggering autonomous downstream deployment.
